description: This file is a shell script used for testing the integration and keyword handling of a Perforce (p4) and Git environment, particularly focusing on RCS keyword expansion, scrubbing, and conflict handling in a version-controlled project.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Defines Python scripts for scrubbing RCS keywords from files to facilitate comparison and testing.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks that the `file` scrubbed with `scrub_k.py` differs from the original but matches the version in 'git'.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Checks that the `file` scrubbed with `scrub_ko.py` differs from the original but matches the 'git' version.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a C source file with RCS keywords for testing keyword expansion and scrubbing.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a timestamp comment to a file and submits it via p4.
